scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @care-y/shared run build:paraglide && pnpm --filter @care-y/client run build:paraglide && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 tsc --build && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 pnpm --filter @care-y/client exec svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json && NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=1536 pnpm --filter @care-y/demo run check
scripts.lint:strict: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 eslint --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ packages/ --rule '@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars: [error, { argsIgnorePattern: ^_, varsIgnorePattern: ^_, caughtErrorsIgnorePattern: ^_ }]'
scripts.test: vitest run --project client --project shared --project crypto && pnpm test:server:db && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:server:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml exec app pnpm vitest run --project server
scripts.test:unit:coverage: vitest run --project client --project shared --project crypto --coverage && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml exec app pnpm vitest run --project server --coverage && mkdir -p coverage/server && docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml cp app:/app/coverage/coverage-final.json coverage/server/coverage-final.json
scripts.test:e2e:seed: docker compose exec -e SEED_ORG_SLUG=e2e-org app pnpm --filter @care-y/server exec tsx src/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.seed: docker compose exec app pnpm --filter @care-y/server exec tsx src/scripts/seed.ts
